exact_result: Actual necessary-and-sufficient finite-dual-energy/probability image theorem for every retained cone admitting one smooth rational projective quotient, for every rational or irrational Reeb field; in particular all normal cones of dimension at most two. New universal supremum-test root homeomorphism and explicit orbit-root L1-tail transfer. Original all-normal all-dimensional theorem remains unproved.
concrete_gaps: No genuine normalized compactness/envelope theorem at arbitrary singular normal rational quotients.
Consequently actual realization for cones without the smooth-quotient hypothesis remains unproved; the normal scalar quadric example demonstrates the hypothesis is not automatic.

The new L1 transfer requires genuine source compactness and bounded-energy L1 continuity. Those hypotheses are established here only on the smooth-quotient domain, and cannot be inferred from the granted signed estimate or I-Cauchyness.
